name: Advanced Filesystem: Quota Manager
description: Granular per-user, per-role and per-bundle file storage quotas enforced on upload, with a usage dashboard, per-user 'My Files' management page and near-limit email alerts. Sub-module of Advanced Filesystem.
project_description: The Quota Manager sub-module of Advanced Filesystem enforces storage limits on file uploads. Rules are stored in the advanced_filesystem_quota_rules table and come in three types — per user (uid), per role, and per entity-type+bundle — with a weight and an optional per-rule action (block or warn). QuotaManager resolves the applicable rules for the current user (uid rules win over role rules over bundle rules; the most restrictive limit applies), sums the user's permanent-file storage from file_managed, and a QuotaFileValidator event subscriber on the core FileValidationEvent blocks or warns when a new upload would exceed the limit. Anonymous users (uid 0) are exempt and uid 1 can optionally bypass. A dashboard (admin/reports/advanced_filesystem/quota) shows every rule with usage progress bars; a per-user 'My Files' page (/user/{user}/my-files, self-or-admin access) lists a user's owned files with a quota banner and per-file delete confirmation (owner-checked). hook_cron sends near-limit email alerts at a configurable threshold and interval, throttled per user via State. Rule CRUD forms and the dashboard are gated by the parent module's 'administer advanced_filesystem' permission; the module ships no permissions of its own.
